digest.scope: the profile object in this response

preTradeUidsHash.inclusion: omit entries equal to zero bytes32
preTradeUidsHash.encoding: concatenate each retained uid as 32 raw bytes without separators

measuredFieldsHash.normalization: deduplicate, sort lexicographically, then join with comma
measuredFieldsHash.encoding: UTF-8 bytes of the normalized string

reasonCodesHash.encoding: ABI encode the sorted values as string[]

destinationPreTradeUid.meaning: no destination pre-trade gate; omitted from preTradeUidsHash

attestationAgeAtExecSeconds.meaning: paired pre-trade attestation did not exist at execution time

verdictRules: NOT_EXECUTED when fillStatus is REVERTED or FAILED
UNDETERMINED when quotedPrice or executedPrice is not positive
UNDETERMINED when preTradeSignedAt is absent, non-positive, or after executedAt
UNDETERMINED when executedAt is after a supplied preTradeValidUntil
UNDETERMINED when bindingMode is not VERIFIED
